root.label: UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance first session

events.label: UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance first session

slots.name: participating states
slots.sentence: The first session was held July 6-7 at Palexpo in Geneva, marking the first international AI forum in which all 193 member states sat at the same table alongside the private sector, civil society, academia, and the technical community.

slots.name: written submissions
slots.sentence: The session was preceded by six months of structured consultations that drew over 1,500 written submissions.

slots.name: establishment date
slots.sentence: The U.N. General Assembly established the global dialogue in resolution A/RES/79/325, following its commitment in the Global Digital Compact , adopted in 2024.
